statement: The frozen restorer (indus_workbench/restore.py; smoothing k=0.01; weights pair 1.0, two-sign 0.15, position 0.25, object 0.25, chosen on exploration fold 0 only) is trained on the exploration split. Every sign of every holdout text of 2+ signs whose exact text does not occur in the exploration split is hidden in turn. Claim: among gaps where the top guess has confidence >= 0.8, the top guess is exactly right more than 70% of the time. p = one-sided exact binomial test of H0: accuracy <= 0.70. Exploration (folds 1-4): 83% at >= 0.8 (results/restoration.md); dry run on an exploration split: 164 of 196 (84%). Planned support: about 150-200 confident gaps, estimated from exploration counts and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout; if below the project minimum of 15, reported as below planned support. Descriptive only, not tested: overall top-1/top-5 of the structured model and of the sign-pair (n-gram) model. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
